training_scenarios: All10 MP_domain true scenarios; all small-design families, failures retained.
selection_rule: Smallest multiplier attaining at least49 of50 joint covers in EVERY in-domain scenario x small family, counting fit failures as uncovered; if none, no tuned route admitted.
holdout_rule: Freeze selected multiplier before reading reps50..99; report heldout metrics with MC bounds. R50 is not the v1 formal5000 validation.
G2_optimization: Target-specific chronological/reverse weighted first-fit, minimum C chosen using only A and metadata; compare with G0/G1.
G3_fallback: For Z=(A Y-lo)/span in[0,1], E Z=(T-lo)/span, Markov gives [lo+delta*(AY-lo),hi-delta*(hi-AY)] with delta=alpha/(2m). Compare worst-case width to graph interval BEFORE seeing Y; choose one per target at the same Bonferroni per-target error. All-dependent graph thereby improves from full to nearly-full range, never claim useful precision.
P2_engineering: Replace Python OU loops by exact stationary daily AR1 lfilter for common time and banded triangular solve for irregular team events; same finite-dimensional Gaussian law, different random-number consumption, versioned fresh streams.
P3_statistical_calibration: Training-based critical multiplier applies to all small families, no real outcomes used. It is a candidate correction, not theorem, and cannot bypass fitted-parameter/full-design formal gates.
